scope: Follow-up coverage for LAFAN40 / G1 29DoF, limited to the three checkpoint releases below.
selection: Only these three releases remain under inspection. Projects without a public checkpoint or with only single-motion checkpoints are no longer being followed.

entries.name: Humanoid-GPT Transformer 216
entries.gap: The author also publishes pns_wo_priv216_trans.onnx (42,977,083 bytes). Its temporal inference contract and complete-suite behavior have not been verified here. Ranked 264 results belong to a different feed-forward checkpoint.
entries.next_step: Audit the released Transformer inference and state/reset semantics before a separate full evaluation.

entries.name: ScaleBFM
entries.gap: The existing converted artifact came from a shared deployment archive; its original-to-export equivalence chain is incomplete.
entries.next_step: Reproduce conversion from the author checkpoint and compare inference.

entries.name: HoloMotion v1.3.1
entries.gap: The released ONNX cache fails at step 8192 in the inspected runtime; its paired author deployment does not supply a verified reset path.
entries.next_step: Verify an author-supported cache/reset procedure. Other HoloMotion versions have separate ranked records.
